title: GPR daily Acts vs Threats decomposition feasibility for volatility forecasting

verdict.plain_english: The design is valid and differentiated from K446, but the current local environment lacks a reproducible raw GPRD/Acts/Threats file and lacks XLE/ITA price snapshots. Running HAR-RV forecasts now would require live downloads, which fail under the current DNS-restricted sandbox.

proposed_design.research_question: Do daily GPR Acts and Threats components add asymmetric predictive power for SPY/GLD/XLE/ITA realized volatility beyond own RV and VIX?
candidate_models: HAR-RV baseline: RV_1d, RV_5d, RV_22d, all lagged one trading day
HAR-RV + VIX_lag1 where VIX is available
tests: DM test on QLIKE/MSE loss differentials
stationary block bootstrap with fixed seed
Harvey-style high-threshold screen for multiple testing caution
proposed_design.lookahead_rule: All predictors must be shifted by at least one trading day before forecasting RV_t or forward RV.

literature_checked.source: Caldara and Iacoviello (2022), American Economic Review
literature_checked.use_in_design: Primary GPR index and Acts/Threats decomposition motivation.

literature_checked.source: IMF Global Financial Stability Report, April 2025, Chapter 2
literature_checked.use_in_design: Motivates asset-price and financial-stability relevance of major geopolitical events.

literature_checked.source: Dai, Dai, and Zhou (2024), GJR-GARCH-MIDAS geopolitical risk and agricultural volatility
literature_checked.use_in_design: Supports testing geopolitical risk as a low-frequency volatility driver, while keeping OOS tests strict.

official_gpr_download.error: URLError: <urlopen error [Errno 8] nodename nor servname provided, or not known>

knowledge_hits: K100: generic geopolitical proxies added little incremental volatility information beyond VIX.
K446: broad daily GPR showed weak/reversed predictive content; VIX->GPR stronger than GPR->RV.

blocking_conditions.detail: No canonical local GPRD/GPRA/GPRT raw file was found, and the official daily XLS could not be downloaded in this sandbox.
Local reusable snapshots lack close prices for: XLE, ITA.

required_to_unlock.rule: Pin the downloaded file locally; do not rely on live download inside the experiment.
Use adjusted closes if available; document vendor and download timestamp.

honesty_note: No regression coefficients, DM statistics, or article-ready claims were produced in this run. The only empirical quantities reused are from the already committed K446 results artifact.
